title: Glass Vowel Hook
description: A vocal-ish formant lead that talks through vowels like a synthetic singer, stepping a e i o u o across a slow loop while envelope-driven vibrato makes it quiver. A swept band-pass and a deepening room tail open the hook from hollow to liquid over a 32-cycle morph.
code:
setcpm(128/4)
stack(
  note("<c4 [c4 d4] f4 eb4 [g4 f4] eb4 d4 c4>/2")
    .s("sawtooth")
    .vowel("<a e i o u o e a>/3")
    .vib(saw.slow(13).range(3.5, 7.5))
    .vibmod(perlin.slow(11).range(0.15, 0.6))
    .bpf(tri.slow(23).range(700, 2600))
    .resonance(perlin.slow(17).range(6, 13))
    .shape(0.18)
    .room(saw.slow(29).range(0.25, 0.78))
    .roomsize(5)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.32, 0.68))
    .off(0.012, x => x.add(note(0.12)).gain(0.5))
    .gain(0.85)
)
